lessons.description: Turn number puzzles into small discoveries. Learners explore patterns, practise useful calculations and explain their ideas through friendly, hands-on challenges. The example session balances independent thinking with small-group problem solving, helping children build confidence at their own pace.
learningOutcomes: Spot number patterns and explain a rule
Try more than one way to solve a puzzle
Describe mathematical thinking clearly

lessons.description: Build a story from a spark of an idea. Young writers try character creation, vivid settings and playful writing prompts, then develop a short piece they can share. The example workshop makes room for different voices and gentle, constructive feedback.
learningOutcomes: Create a character with a clear goal
Use sensory detail to build a setting
Plan and revise a short story

lessons.description: Discover how an idea becomes an interactive project. Learners break a problem into steps, try simple programming concepts and improve their work through testing. The example club encourages collaboration and curiosity, with small challenges that make logical thinking feel practical.
learningOutcomes: Describe an algorithm as clear steps
Use sequences and simple decisions
Test a project and explain a change

lessons.description: Explore characters, movement and storytelling through drama games. Learners practise listening, improvisation and working together before building a short group scene. The example studio gives children space to experiment and share ideas without pressure to perform perfectly.
learningOutcomes: Use voice and movement to express a character
Respond to a partner during improvisation
Contribute to a short group scene

lessons.description: Ask a question, make a prediction and investigate what happens. Learners explore everyday scientific ideas through supervised example activities, observation and discussion. The programme focuses on careful thinking and recording results, helping curiosity develop into a useful method.
learningOutcomes: Make a prediction with a reason
Record observations clearly
Compare results with an initial idea

lessons.description: Learn the board, discover how pieces move and try a little strategic thinking. Learners practise with friendly puzzles and short games, taking time to explain their choices. The example club values patience, fair play and learning from the next move.
learningOutcomes: Recognise legal moves for each piece
Look for a simple tactic
Reflect on a move and consider an alternative

lessons.description: Make room for colour, texture and original ideas. Learners experiment with drawing and mixed-media approaches, then build a piece around a creative prompt. This example workshop celebrates the process of making, with time to discuss choices and discover new techniques.
learningOutcomes: Explore colour and mark-making
Combine materials in an original composition
Explain a creative choice

lessons.description: Start making music one small step at a time. Learners explore rhythm, basic technique and simple chord patterns through guided practice. The example session supports beginners with approachable exercises and encourages listening as well as playing.
learningOutcomes: Keep a steady pulse
Practise a simple chord transition
Play a short pattern with control

lessons.description: Build ball skills through friendly drills and small-group games. Learners practise control, passing and movement while developing communication and fair play. The example programme focuses on participation and steady improvement, with challenges that can be adapted to different starting points.
learningOutcomes: Control the ball during a simple drill
Pass accurately to a teammate
Use communication and fair play in a game

lessons.description: Discover movement, rhythm and the foundations of ballet through a welcoming beginner session. Learners explore posture, coordination and short movement sequences. The example programme encourages careful practice and expression, with time to repeat and build confidence.
learningOutcomes: Recognise basic positions
Coordinate movement with a musical pulse
Remember a short movement sequence

lessons.description: Meet a new language through conversation, games and everyday themes. Learners practise greetings, useful words and simple exchanges in French. The example session makes repetition playful and encourages children to try speaking, listening and responding with growing confidence.
learningOutcomes: Use a greeting and introduce yourself
Recognise familiar everyday words
Take part in a short question-and-answer exchange

lessons.description: Connect coding ideas with a practical design challenge. Learners plan a simple robotic behaviour, consider how inputs affect actions and test improvements as a team. The example lab values clear reasoning, patient experimentation and explaining how a design works.
learningOutcomes: Describe an input-process-output system
Plan a simple robotic behaviour
Use test results to improve a design

teachers.bio: Mina helps learners turn questions into practical investigations and thoughtful problem solving. This is a fictitious coursework profile.
Theo creates space for learners to experiment with language, characters and new ideas. This is a fictitious coursework profile.
Sarah encourages creative practice through visual art, music and expressive movement. This is a fictitious coursework profile.
Leo uses hands-on challenges to connect logical thinking, teamwork and practical skills. This is a fictitious coursework profile.
